content:
Post 1

📈 ASX 200 hit a new 50-day high Wednesday, closing at 9,153.20, +0.27%. Five-day run now +3.61%, just 1.54% from the 52-week peak. Tech and lithium led. The rally has legs — but the ceiling is close. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

IT topped sectors at +1.52%, Utilities +1.30%, Materials +0.77%. Only Financials finished red at -0.35%. Breadth was solid — ten of eleven sectors green. When banks lag a broad rally, watch whether they catch up or drag. #ASX #ausbiz #banking

Post 3

🔺 Life360 surged +10.05% to AUD 20.81, the session's standout. Elevra Lithium followed at +9.70% to AUD 4.07. Lithium names finding buyers again — ELV, SRL, PLS all in the top five. #ASX #lithium #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,909.64/oz. Silver AUD 76.97/oz. Platinum AUD 2,288.45/oz. AUD/USD at 0.6878. Metals holding firm in local terms — a softer Aussie dollar amplifying returns for gold holders. #gold #metals #ASX #ausbiz

Post 5

Index sits 1.54% from its 52-week high. The question for the rest of the week: can Financials join the rally? Banks lagging while IT runs is a split worth watching. Where do you see the ASX 200 by Friday? #ASX #ausbiz #investing
